# Social Fashion Feed

Infinite scroll feed, outfit/designer/creator posts, likes, comments, saves, shares (internal), follow system.

Acceptance criteria:
- Users can post images and captions tied to a creator/designer.
- Feed supports infinite scroll with server-side pagination.
- Users can like, comment, save, and share posts internally.
- Users can follow/unfollow creators and see followed creators' content prioritized.

Success metric: DAU/MAU ratio > 40%
